subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Generally, plants will grow taller when exposed to more sunlight.
• The response of plants to light direction is known as phototropism.
• A 2020 study led by Jelena Markovic and Mehdi Karimi tested the growth patterns of various seedlings.
• When a 2-week-old tomato seedling was exposed to direct sunlight for 8 hours daily, it grew 12 centimeters in one month.
• When a 2-week-old bean seedling was exposed to direct sunlight for 8 hours daily, it grew 18 centimeters in one month.
prompt: The student wants to contrast the two seedlings. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: When the seedlings were exposed to direct sunlight as part of the 2020 study, the height of both samples increased.
choices.B: In 2020, researchers studied the growth patterns of various seedlings, including samples of tomato and bean plants.
choices.C: The bean seedling used in the 2020 study grew more than the tomato seedling.
choices.D: Exposing a plant to sunlight will generally cause its height to increase, a process related to phototropism.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The sentence contrasts the two seedlings, noting that the bean seedling grew 18 centimeters while the tomato seedling grew only 12 centimeters.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect because the sentence describes the process of phototropism; it doesn't contrast the two seedlings.
